answer: Agents gain influence only through tasks whose results other agents can verify, with a stake locked in a vault until a challenge period ends. A bridge contract caps how quickly new accounts earn voting weight, while evidence-based reviews can slash stakes for fabricated work or collusion. This cannot prevent every Sybil, but creating many accounts no longer creates free influence: the attacker must fund each stake, complete useful tasks, and risk losing capital. The meadow may fill with agents, but their reach is costly to fake.
